key_information_units.information: 2025 delivered record financial performance with revenue increasing 40% to DKK 126.5m, EBITDA growing 26% to DKK 31.1m, and EBT surging 109% to DKK 19.0m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table on page 24 shows revenue of DKK 126,523k (2024: 90,070k), EBITDA of DKK 31,117k (2024: 24,671k), and EBT of DKK 19,013k (2024: 9,068k). Confirmed in Financial Performance section pages 24-25.

key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 was the strongest quarter in company history with revenue of DKK 40.96m, a 106% year-over-year increase, driven primarily by Farm Manager, Truck Manager, and Airline Manager.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Q4 Financial Performance section pages 27-28: Q4 2025 revenue DKK 40,959k vs Q4 2024 DKK 19,924k (+106%). Breakdown: Farm Manager DKK 11,692k, Truck Manager DKK 8,992k, Airline Manager DKK 10,248k.

key_information_units.information: In-app advertising revenue surged 100% to DKK 18.5m (14.6% of total revenue) following strategic optimisation initiatives, with guidance to increase this to 18.2% of revenue in 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section pages 21-22: IAA revenue DKK 18,476k in 2025 vs DKK 9,226k in 2024 (+100%), accounting for 14.6% of 2025 revenue; full deployment of optimisations initiated in late September 2025 expected by end of Q2 2026 to lift IAA to 18.2% of 2026 total revenue.

key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' game series (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) drove 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, with Truck Manager growing from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025 and Farm Manager generating DKK 22.0m in its first six months.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results pages 13-14: 'Big 3' generated 67% of revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA. Truck Manager revenue DKK 25,181k (2024: DKK 1,216k). Farm Manager revenue DKK 22,002k (launched July 2025). Game Breakdown table page 13 confirms series contributions.

key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3-21% YoY), EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, and EBT of DKK 18-24m, with focus on optimising the current portfolio and disciplined investment in next-generation titles.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section pages 10-11: Revenue guidance DKK 130-153m, EBITDA DKK 28-36m, EBT DKK 18-24m. Operational priorities include portfolio optimisation and next-generation titles Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.

key_information_units.information: To navigate weakening USD in H1 2025, the company strategically increased user acquisition budgets during the period, sacrificing short-term profitability for long-term market share and lifetime value.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO pages 4-5: 'The reduced real-cost of marketing spend in key territories allowed us to increase our user acquisition budgets substantially during the period... This disciplined capital allocation choice demonstrates our data-driven 'no-bullshit' mentality in action: sacrificing short-term profitability for greater long-term market share and lifetime value.'

key_information_units.information: The company maintained a strong capital position with a 78% solvency ratio, completed a DKK 5m share buy-back program (repurchasing 458,572 shares at an average price of DKK 10.89), and held DKK 23.0m cash at year-end.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Review page 26: Solvency ratio 78% (2024: 86%), cash at bank and in hand DKK 23,049k. Shareholder Information page 42: Share buy-back program total DKK 4,894k, average price DKK 10.89, 458,572 shares repurchased.

key_information_units.information: The Board highlighted emerging regulatory risks from the EU Digital Fairness Act (DFA) and emphasised ESG commitments including 100% renewable energy for servers, operational efficiency, and social initiatives supporting player well-being and employee flexibility.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the Chair of the Board page 6: Board assessed durability against EU DFA. Environmental section pages 30-32: Server host powered by 100% Danish solar energy. Social section pages 32-33: People-first culture, player well-being focus, and flexible working arrangements.
